rules.light_mode_controls: tabs, buttons, fields and ears are light with dark text
rules.custom_color_handling: correct toward accessible contrast for UI text
rules.translations: use i18n catalog, not document content
rules.all_ears_hover: left/right auxiliary tabs and both upper dock toggles receive subtle palette hover
rules.scrollbars: all UI scroll areas use palette scrollTrack/scrollThumb/scrollThumbHover
rules.no_hardcoded_burgundy_in_other_palettes: theme all thumbnails, selected tool borders, checkbox accents, chrome icons; do not recolor actual PDF
rules.ocr_and_colorwell: use semantic section and input tokens; all light palettes must stay light
rules.scope: visual CSS and semantic token map only; no core logic changes
rules.theme_quick_toggle: same settingsApplied theme state; header half moon button plus Settings/Interface
rules.note_labels: default palette accent and user custom color with contrast; demo per-label override
rules.logo_settings_icons: logo ~3.8 px shorter; setting 18 px; text cursor 14.5 px
